title: ActivityWidget
wrapsNative: MonarchWidget (a VStack card with a Menu and a View all Button) holding a compact MonarchActivityTimeline (a VStack of event rows)
summary: A recipe, not a component: the recent-activity card of a dashboard, a MonarchWidget around a compact MonarchActivityTimeline of the latest few events, with View all leading to the full log.
whenToUse: On a dashboard or a Space home screen that shows what changed recently, when the full activity log is another screen.
whenNotToUse: For the full log or an audit trail, push a screen with MonarchActivityTimeline on its own. For the person's own notifications, use the notification center pattern.

states.name: ready
states.description: The first events, newest first. Pass only the latest few (the web default is 6); View all opens the rest.

states.name: loading
states.description: Pass isLoading to the timeline so the card shows the timeline's own redacted placeholder rows.

states.name: empty
states.description: The timeline shows its empty text; set labels.empty to "No activity yet" or the product's wording.

states.name: failed
states.description: Set the widget's state to .failed with onRetry: the card shows the error with Try again instead of the timeline.

appearance: The widget's surface and subtle border with its title row, then the compact timeline: tone-coloured dots or avatars, the sentence in the default text colour and the time in the muted text colour. The same roles change with dark and high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ActivityWidget is a component with a limit prop and its own "Recent activity" and "No activity yet" strings. On iOS it composes MonarchWidget and MonarchActivityTimeline: the app passes the first events (events.prefix(6)) and its own title, which it has already localised, so Monarch ships no strings for the recipe. The web view-all link is an href; on iOS onViewAll pushes the full log in the navigation stack. The web time zone prop has no counterpart: the timeline formats in the device time zone. Android uses the same recipe.
accessibility: The widget title is read as a header, then each event as one sentence: actor, verb, object and time.
Automated actors carry the visible "Automated" tag from the timeline, so people and rules are told apart without colour.
View all and the retry button are standard buttons with 44-point touch targets.
edgeCases: Keep the list short: the card does not scroll on its own, so pass five or six events and lead to the full log.
Pass now from a fixed clock in tests and previews so relative times do not change between runs.
Ungrouped (isGroupedByDay: false) reads better in a short card; grouped by day suits a taller widget.

examples.webExample: Recent activity with a view-all link
examples.code:
MonarchWidget("Recent activity", onViewAll: {}) {
    MonarchActivityTimeline(
        [
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id: "1",
                actor: MonarchActivityTimelineActor("Ada Moss"),
                verb: "closed",
                object: "Request 1042",
                time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_051_600)
            ),
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id: "2",
                actor: MonarchActivityTimelineActor("Renewal rule", kind: .automation),
                verb: "flagged",
                object: "Contract 88",
                time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_045_900),
                tone: .warning
            ),
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id: "3",
                actor: MonarchActivityTimelineActor("Bea Lund"),
                verb: "commented on",
                object: "Request 1039",
                time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_039_300)
            ),
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id: "4",
                actor: MonarchActivityTimelineActor("Cal Ortiz"),
                verb: "created",
                object: "Project Atlas",
                time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_793_980_800)
            ),
        ],
        isGroupedByDay: false,
        density: .compact,
        now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_052_800),
        labels: MonarchActivityTimelineLabels(list: "Recent activity")
    )
}
.environment(\.timeZone, TimeZone(identifier: "UTC") ?? .gmt)
